newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus sets up Spain film rights unit.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus sets up Spain film rights unit.

text.p: Canal Plus said on Tuesday it and Sogecable, its Spanish unit, set up Sogepaq Television, a Madrid-based film and broadcasting rights distribution company.

"The new company, based in Madrid, will sell the video and television rights of Canal Plus' and Sogecable's common catalogue, which includes over 5,000 feature films and 2,000 hours of television programmes," Canal Plus said in a statement.
It said Sogepaq Television would be the biggest film and broadcasting rights company in Spain and would have a leading position in distribution.
